- **Studio:** make a movie from an album, a memory or a selection; trim a clip by editing its transcript; export vertical or square videos that reframe automatically; and generate music again.
- **Duplicates:** review exact copies and look-alike photos in separate lanes.
- **Undo for deletes:** uploading a photo you deleted in the last 24 hours brings the original back.
- **Locked items:** "Mark sensitive" is now "Lock" and "Unlock".
- **Albums:** clearer delete wording, icon search, Escape closes dialogs, and your selection stays after Add to album.
- **Imports and restores:** lost originals are kept and repaired, and restoring a backup onto a new server or a new owner works end to end.
- **Accounts:** deleting a user removes every file they owned.
- **Manager:** run more than one Frameleaf on the same server.
- **Docker:** Compose installs start once the database is healthy and keep their project name across upgrades.
- Security fixes.
